common.title: Title
welcome.headline: Check in with a live QR. Manage the day from one place.
welcome.body: Signed tokens refresh every 20 seconds, GPS confirms the branch, and managers see late arrivals and task progress instantly.
welcome.qr_body: Temporary signed kiosk codes that expire before they can be reused.
welcome.site_body: Check-in uses the kiosk code. Location is saved but never blocks attendance.
welcome.role_body: Super admin, branch admin, manager, and employee views stay separate.
welcome.tasks_body: Assign work to people or a whole department, with comments and files.
